intents.message: Catalogue the AI systems our clinics rely on, then use that to set out how we respond when one causes harm.
First map out which AI tools each department uses; after that, write the plan for AI failures.
Audit our AI use across programs and base an AI incident response procedure on what you find.
Line up every open grant opportunity by due date, then draft the application that's due first.
Start by organizing our funder prospects and deadlines; then write the proposal for the most urgent.
Build our grants calendar and use it to begin the next LOI.
We can't say which AI products our staff rely on. Draft how we'd handle an AI-caused incident anyway.
Nobody knows which funder deadline is next. Write our next grant application.
We run a donor chatbot and an eligibility model. Write the playbook for when either causes harm.
Give us a severity scale and the first-hour steps for an AI system that produces a harmful answer.
Write the LOI to the Birchwood Foundation, $45,000 for our literacy tutors, due April 10.
Draft the narrative section of a proposal for our after-school program.

Build our grants calendar with every deadline and its stage.
